text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's Oguri Cap! Oguri Cap has taken
the lead
and... she's passed the finish
line!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Maaan! Oguri's the coolest! She totally
kicked our
butts!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong. I'm super frustrated
that I
lost... but at the same time...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You were incredible today. Your passion
was so
hot, I thought it might burn me...
It really pushed
me to perform even
better than usual.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's race again someday.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: O-of course! I wouldn't miss it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Until then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How can your eyes still sparkle like that?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
We both came face-to-face with the
same
unbelievable force, yet I... All I can
do is think
about how much stronger she
is... and how
powerless I am.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But that unbelievable power of hers is
exactly
what makes her such a great
rival!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I have Oguri to block my
path and act
as a huge, towering wall
that I've got to conquer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The stronger she is, the more
exhilarating it'll be
when I finally beat
her! It's a seemingly impossible

challenge with a seemingly invincible
foe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why, for me, Oguri's not someone
who
devours dreams! It's the total
opposite!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She's like a towering GIANT, egging me
on to
take her down! She's the one who
lit this fire in
me, and now my dreams
and I both burn bright!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I never realized how different the
two of
us are.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I suppose at some point I must have
forgotten the
mindset necessary to take
on such towering
adversaries.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Do you think I can do it as well?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Can I face strong opponents head-on
the way you
do?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course you can!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: After all, you're the one who taught me that you can improve yourself by facing strong opponents in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall reclaim my initial mindset and set
out once
more to face mighty
opponents.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll continue chasing my dream!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Look at Yaeno's face! Doesn't she look a
little
more positive? Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she sensed the same thing that
we did
from Bamboo's run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There is simply no one more dedicated
to her
dreams than Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's like watching her gives you the
strength
to chase your own!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory and I finally get back
to
campus. She was quieter than usual
on our way
back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But suddenly, she stops in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You were incredible today. Your passion
was so
hot, I thought it might burn me...
It really pushed
me to perform even
better than usual.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's race again someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I look back, I notice tears welling up
in her
eyes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why do you a—
choice_data_list: バンブー！？どうしたんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Agh, why are my eyes all watery?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hold on! I'm fine, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fine! I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
After all this time, I was fiiinally able to
throw
everything I had at Oguri in a G1
race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It just makes me sooo happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without warning, large tears start
spilling down
Bamboo Memory's face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is not only the quietest I've ever
seen her,
but also the most raw and
emotional.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! From the moment I started
running, it's
always been my destiny to
face her!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She's the one who stands at the very
center of my
dream. She's my ultimate
rival—a part of my story!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So maybe that's why...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be a part of Oguri Cap's story
too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I want her and everyone else to say Bamboo Memory is Oguri Cap's ultimate rival!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's who I want to be!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I want to run in the
Sprinters
Stakes next!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There, I'll prove myself as the best
sprinter ever!
I'll become the best
version of myself and
someone worthy of
being Oguri's rival!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's passion is so strong, I
can feel
my own eyes begin to water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, this is where I have to
step up! If
she wants to become Oguri
Cap's rival, then I
know just what she
needs to do!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But that's a medium-distance race!
choice_data_list: その前に『宝塚記念』へ出走しよう
choice_data_list_en: Before that, let's enter the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But?
choice_data_list: 厳しい戦いにはなると思う。でも――
choice_data_list_en: I know it's going to be a tough fight. But――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: そこには、ヤエノとチヨノオーが出てくる
choice_data_list_en: Yaeno and Chiyono O will be competing in that one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And not just them. The best racers in this

generation are sure to make an
appearance. The
Takarazuka Kinen is a
grand prix, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory has nurtured an
increasingly
strong passion for her dream
thanks to the time
she's spent with
Yaeno Muteki and the rest of her
peers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she competes in a race where so many
of her
generation's dreams collide...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 絶対、君を強くしてくれるはずだ！
絶対、貴方を強くしてくれるはずだよ！
choice_data_list_en: This will definitely make you stronger!
This will definitely make you stronger!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Okay, then! Takarazuka Kinen, here I
come!
